description: Percentage of Time the Mobile Device Services Cellular Network is Available is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Shared Services Canada | Services partagés Canada. This availability indicator measures the % of time the cellular network / infrastructure is available, as provided by the contracted supplier(s). The indicator does not automatically monitor and measure the availability of individual user devices. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Shared Services Canada | Services partagés Canada. Its tags are cadre ministériel des résultats, indicateurs de résultats ministériels, télécommunications, appareils mobiles et téléphones fixes, Departmental Results Framework. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-02-18 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
